body:

[Clear] AR3000 is wired so that's a different category altogether. Now you go post some $200 Momentums.
[jasswolf] I'm all for a good deal on AliE and respect your work, but this headphone has been critically - and rightfully - canned. Feel free to post a capable expert review that suggests otherwise.
[Clear] Where's the $200 Momentums? You can't leave us hanging.
[jasswolf] @Clear:
Where's the $200 Momentums?
Later this month.
Where's the value in this headphone?
[Clear] @jasswolf: Ah so you can't even currently get them for $200 despite saying you can. Post them when they're available.
You linked the wrong headphones also.
[jasswolf] @Clear: Fair enough, but the Pro is the upgrade, and it's panned as hard as any preceding Nothing audio product.
They are features and comfort first, audio distant third.
And this perpetually childish argument of 'AH BUT NOT RIGHT NOW', when 99% of the people on this website can surely wait 2 weeks… some of the regulars on here need to go outside.
[Clear] @jasswolf: It took a few updates for the (1) to get better anyway. Even a few days ago there were reports of them sounding good. Not to mention the level of flexibility you get with the EQ settings and profiles available.
And this perpetually childish argument of 'AH BUT NOT RIGHT NOW', when 99% of the people on this website can surely wait 2 weeks… some of the regulars on here need to go outside.
Or perhaps people should stop making claims about something else 'better' being available for less when it isn't , or basing their entire argument on a completely different product .
[jasswolf] @Clear: It doesn't outpoint the Momentum 4 even with EQ, which is a local deal with warranty regularly around this price level. Yes, the cashbacks won't be quite as deep, but you have the option of a low latency dongle.
Sorry for misreading the title but I have been asked about Nothing phones and Nothing headphones for years, and they are consistently half-baked R&D projects to wow consumers while they hope to finish the work on the run.
Sadly their leadership is overly-ambitious and cheap rather than scummy, but the point remains for the end user.
[M00Cow] @jasswolf:
And this perpetually childish argument of 'AH BUT NOT RIGHT NOW',
But unless you're some sort of insider how can you know what the future price will be? You're just making it up as you go along
